purpose: R1-P backdoor scan classification. Vendor globals are excluded by an explicit key allowlist in preview_verify.py; the generic `window.__` prefix is NEVER whitelisted. An unlisted project-owned global, or any entry with can_force_economic_state=true, fails the scan.
